claim: The project is a purposefully selected 22-object empirical audit, not a field-wide prevalence estimate.
forbidden_wording: systematic census of all oncology biomarkers

claim: Published response association, randomized effect modification and external validation are distinct evidence layers.
forbidden_wording: all published biomarkers failed randomized validation

claim: TRIO Arms 1 and 2 are randomized by design, whereas Arm 3 participant-level phase is unresolved in public data.
forbidden_wording: all public participants have identical phase uncertainty

claim: TRIO aggregate compatibility constraints do not identify marker-by-treatment interaction.
forbidden_wording: confidence interval or corrected interaction bound

claim: Source-defined AVAglio analysis populations and model specifications change the interaction estimate.
forbidden_wording: independent replication or causal contribution of each covariate

claim: Phillips A2 is imprecise and Verhaak A2 is nominally significant in the shared 333-row unadjusted population.
allowed_wording: report HR, CI and P without cross-classifier promotion

claim: Historical strict-denominator labels cannot be used as the current verified denominator.
allowed_wording: current strict proportion was not estimable

claim: Absolute-effect sensitivity did not promote any frozen primary label.
CHER-LOB within-trial calculations remain separate from the TRIO population-identity problem.
allowed_wording: CHER-LOB estimates retained; paired strict replication not established

claim: TRIO and AVAglio illustrate two distinct correction outcomes: inferential qualification and numerical reconstruction.
